## Checks

- [ ] `go vet ./...` and `go test ./...` pass
- [ ] `go run ./cmd/provguard bench --check` passes (no missed attack, no new false alarm)
- [ ] A new block or ask has a test that shows it
- [ ] The CHANGELOG has an entry under "Unreleased"
